description: Searches walmart.com (US) by keyword and returns up to 20 products from the first results page (title, url, price, rating, reviews_count, availability, seller). It does not search other Walmart countries and does not return reviews or price history; for prices at other stores use google_shopping_prices. Required: query.

query.description: Product search text, 1-500 characters, e.g. "coffee maker".

results.description: Maximum products returned, integer 1-20, default 10, e.g. 5.

name: search_walmart
title: Search Walmart
